notes.title: Patch Notes v1.1.0
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

It has now been two full months since the launch of Stories from Sol: The Gun-Dog, and across all platforms and communities, we've received an outpouring of love and support for the game and we are grateful for all the suggestions, critiques, and expectations you've shared. It's been some time since our last update, and today we’re rolling out a new patch to address some of the concerns.

In this patch, we are adding a new screen scaling option,  delivering the special rewards to beta players who participated in the survey, and taking the opportunity to fix some bugs.

Full details are listed below:

[h3]- Add "Scaling mode" option[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Stretch" is the existing display mode
[*] "Sharp" will show the pixels perfectly, adding black bars around the edge of the screen if necessary
[/list]
[h3]- Add experimental font option for OpenDyslexic[/h3]

[h3]- Add cosmetic bonus content for players who completed the survey at the end of the Steam demo[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Cassie Jacket[/b]: Can be enabled in the Options to show Cassie wearing the jacket you placed over her when she was unconscious at the end of the demo
[*] [b]Bonus photos[/b]: Go to Cassie's quarters to see some extra photos of you and Cassie
[/list]
[b]*If you've completed the survey but can't see the bonus content, please let us know in the pinned discussion thread on Steam.[/b]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix not being able to re-enter Cassie's quarters before the O'Brien
[*] Fix choosing to confront Vanessa sometimes playing the Hansen capture sequence
[*] Fix datapad unlock task not updating when the password is auto-completed
[*] Update the scrollbar in the narrative map to make it more visible
[*] Fix visual issue with Cassie Down Graphic
[*] Fix visual issue with Gun-Dog Shooting animation
[*] Fix visual issue in CM Foam animation
[*] Fix visual issue when viewing the history screen during the ending
[*] Fix scanlines not showing in the main menu
[*] Fix some typos in Spanish localisation
[*] Fix typos in early game Fire Control
[*] Fix ITEM button not flashing in the Central Computer in part 16
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update Notes
notes.notes:
Dear Crew Members of Gun-Dog,

Thank you for supporting!
Based on the feedback we have collected from the community, we have made a few adjustments to ensure a smoother game play experience for players. 

[b]Controller support[/b]
Controller support has been significantly upgraded. It should now feel a lot more natural. 
[list]
[*] Display a bar/icon next to the focused item in menus
[*] The right analog stick now performs the same action as mouse scrolling up/down
[*] This includes opening and closing the new history menu
[*] All menus should now open with the first item focused
[*] The B button consistently backs out of the current menu or action
[*] The top button (Xbox: Y, PS: triangle, Nintendo: X) now opens the map
[/list]
[b]Quality of life[/b]
[list]
[*] Cancel the selected action (MOVE, LOOK etc) when pressing escape/right click
[*] WASD keys now function the same as the arrow keys
[*] Open Save menu when pressing "Q"
[*] Open Load menu when pressing "Z"
[*] Open the Map when pressing "M" or "F"
     - "M" is expected for English-speaking players, but "F" can be reached with the left hand
[/list]
[b]History screen[/b]
History screen has been reworked to fit more naturally into the game flow.
[list]
[*] Scrolling up or pressing T now opens the dialogue history screen
[*]  Scrolling down, pressing escape or B on a controller will close it
[*] History menu item has been removed
[/list]
[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduce line height for the Japanese font to fit 4 lines of dialogue on screen
[/list]
In addition, we fixed some tiny known bugs and optimized several displays and functions. As always, we actively listen to the voices of our player base and optimize our game accordingly. Please do not hesitate to reach out to us with your comments, suggestions, or concerns. 

Until Next Time,
The Development Team & Astrolabe Games
June 20, 2023
